declared: before any cycle-3 R3 development run (after the cycle-2 held-out result, which is now development data)
purpose: Held-out conditions for confirming the cycle-3 R3 design (protocol v1.4.0). Not used for development.
rule: PASS iff median HV(R3) > median HV(NSGA-II) in at least 6 of 8 cells; STRONG iff additionally median HV(R3) > max HV(NSGA-II) in at least 6 of 8 cells; otherwise FAIL. Unchanged from cycles 1-2; ties count against R3.
multiplicity_note: Third confirmatory cycle. Cycle 1 (H1-H4) failed 2/8; cycle 2 (H5-H8) failed 5/8. Both are now development data.
